## Research Profile

My academic work bridges **quantum science**, **cybersecurity**, **artificial intelligence**, and **applied data science**—from supervising large-scale student research portfolios at the **Institute of Technology of Cambodia (ITC)** to hands-on projects in threat detection, market analytics, and scientific computing.

I hold an **M.S. and B.S. in Information Technology** (GPA **3.91**, ASEAN Hub Scholar, Prince Sirindhorn Scholar) and combine classroom leadership with practitioner experience in security operations, consulting, and production-oriented ML systems.

**Contact for collaboration:** [sophalcamchan38@gmail.com](mailto:sophalcamchan38@gmail.com) · [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/sophalchan)

### Supervised Student Research (Selected)

## Research Themes in Progress

- **Quantum science applications:** exploring how quantum-inspired and quantum-ready methods relate to optimization and security-relevant computation.
- **AI-driven cybersecurity:** intrusion detection, containerized inference APIs, and SOC-aligned analytics.
- **Cambodia-focused data science:** open student research corpora for reproducible teaching and regional market intelligence.
